summary: Blue Gold Ltd, a Cayman-incorporated metal mining foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K disclosing an abrupt leadership overhaul effective September 17, 2026: Andrew Cavaghan resigned as Chairman, CEO and director, replaced as Executive Chairman by Kevin Clark; Gary Herman joined as non-executive director and Audit Committee Chairman, replacing Tao Tan, alongside related financial and accounting service changes. A Transition and Settlement Agreement with Cavaghan is filed as an exhibit; the company stated the resignation was not due to any disagreement. No price, stake or deal terms apply. Watch for further executive turnover, restated financials, or strategic alternatives signals.
